identityReview: Jared Taylor Isaacman, American entrepreneur, pilot and commercial astronaut; NASA 15th administrator. Distinct from father Donald Isaacman and successor Taylor Lauber. Birth year 1983 uses secondary identity biography; exact birthday and private family details omitted.
lifeStatusEvidence: November 16, 2026 NASA release quotes Isaacman as current administrator. Dated official statement, not an independently witnessed appearance.

corrections: December 17, 2025 Senate confirmation and Shift4 board resignation are distinct from December 18 swearing-in. January 2026 website update is not appointment date.
June 4 CEO resignation and June 5 executive-chair/Lauber CEO appointment follow proxy; corporate board role continued until December.
Bachelors degree is aeronautics, not aerospace engineering. Honorary doctorate is not a research degree.
Inspiration4 first all-civilian orbital flight, not first civilian spaceflight of any kind; September 15 uses Florida local time.
September 12 commercial spacewalk includes Sarah Gillis, other crew and SpaceX; not individual invention. Conflicting published clock times omitted.
Mission peak altitude differs from spacewalk altitude; historical distance record not presented as current after Artemis II.
NASA clean audit is an opinion on financial statements, not blanket program approval or personal award. Sixteen-year institutional record is longer than his tenure.
1999 business origin is distinct from later listed holding-company incorporation. Draken 2011 origin distinct from acquired British predecessors.
Initial and withdrawn nomination saga not included without direct primary chronology review. No inferred divestment, current Draken ownership or old net worth.
